items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: I don't remember them. No, I don't.

ctx.x: See, I asked you about Leonard Parker and Dan Moody. You don't remember them?
I don't remember them. No, I don't.
Black Eagle Vels there. You don't remember them? Those are people George Lewis has mentioned to me, playing over there. Who are some of the people you heard here in town?
